steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Go back, humans shouldn't step into this park.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...He's human. And he's not an illusion.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Go back... No matter how many times you try, you'll never reach her.
You go forward. The old man has white hair and is draped in a tattered colorful flag, leaning on one of the amusement park's flags a little feebly. His consciousness is as murky as his eyes.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Yes... Hamel... Beautiful Hamel, gentle Hamel...

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: She can captivate everyone with one single dance... Everyone needs her, everyone chases after her... Everyone loves her...

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Her dance created the Carnival... Accepting everyone... but me... It doesn't accept humans...

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: This is the Carnival of DisCity, Hamel's Carnival... A paradise created from the most beautiful dance...

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: It's a haven without fear, a sweet dream without pain, a paradise without regrets... An endless carnival...

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: A carnival that rejects humans...

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: I'm here to see her...

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: I want to find Hamel, I want to see her, I want to see it once more... See her dance...

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: But she refuses to see me. I can never enter this world, I can never see her again...
The old man's voice grows lower and lower, repeating the same words blankly.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Go away, the park is not for humans, you'll only get lost if you stay...

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Lost on the way to see her, and you'll never get to see her...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Is this geezer a loony too? He sounds delusional, did he also catch the Mania?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Maniacs can't last this long in a Black Ring. He seems to have lingered around here for a long time already, perhaps something unusual has happened to him.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: He looks more like a village chief in a video game who guides you. Makes a good match with that silly mascot at the gate, one to lure you in and the other to scare you away.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What now? We haven't got any answers and we can't go inside the park. Can we turn back?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: He's said humans don't belong in the Carnival.

steps.content: No matter how well it's concealed by the illusion, this is a parade and paradise for the Corruptors. You still recall vividly, at that moment of discovery, all the Corruptors have their attention on you, not the two Sinners who stepped into the parade first.
Does it make you easier to spot because your M value is constantly low?
If this guess is valid, perhaps there's a way to sneak in. You beckon to the two Sinners.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You want us to keep our abilities activated and sneak into the parade?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I still remember the analysis done by SALVA.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Both Sinners had high M values which <color=#fb9259>increased significantly when using their abilities</color>.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Tsk, you mean to say we're like monsters, don't you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Sigh, whatever, as long as it works. But what are you going to do?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'll try to use the shackles, or my power.

steps.content: Strengthening your connection with the Sinners may blur the distinction between you and them.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...That doesn't sound like a plan. But anyway, it doesn't hurt to try. The worst case, we get kicked out again. Those guys don't look like they're gonna attack us.
As Hella and Hecate keep their Sinner abilities activated, you walk between the two of them. The three of you sneak into the marching parade again.

steps.speaker: Mascots
steps.content: The performance is about to begin, the performance is about to begin...!

steps.speaker: Mascots
steps.content: Hamel! Hamel! Hamel's performance is about to begin!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Phew... They don't seem to notice?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Before that, keep going as far as we can.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, you're sweating buckets, are you alright?

Using the power continuously is quickly exhausting your mental energy. You're beginning to feel worn out and probably can't go on like this for long. You must go as far as possible now and exit the parade before you're completely drained, then find a place to rest.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What a crappy plan you've made, it's clearly not working. Get out, let's get out now, quick...

As she's dragging you out of the parade anxiously, a mascot stumbles by and jostles at Hella. Your formation is disrupted and the mascot happens to fall in front of you, staring into your eyes blankly.

steps.speaker: Mascot
steps.content: Hmm...? Hehe!

steps.speaker: Mascot
steps.content: Lost again! Lost again! <size=44>These fools have lost their way again</size>!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh no!! Again?!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Get out of the parade now and find somewhere to hide!
